basis: The printing heads this gloss 'VERS. 40.' and it opens 'Vers. 40. Vives in gladio. Per hoc enim significat Judaeos crudeliter Christum'. The chapter is Migne's caput, carried from the last one the printing states, and the lemma raises nothing against it.
date_basis: Remigius taught at Reims and then at Paris and died about 908. His scriptural commentaries are products of that teaching and are not separately dated; the range covers the years in which he taught. The date is the writing, not Migne's 1853 printing.
text: Vers. 40. Vives in gladio. Per hoc enim significat Judaeos crudeliter Christum persecuturos et omnes prophetas et apostolos. Fratri servies. Quia Idumaei tributarii fuerunt Israel, qui Jacob vocabatur. Tempusque veniet. Tempus illud significat quo rebellaverunt Judaei ne essent sub Juda.
